description: LOC-004 (EXP-0059): the approved Latin name art for the pilot select (bank 56, SELECT.VAD) and the VS screen (bank 63, PL3F_0.BIN). New art, approved by the user on 2026-11-06 under GATE-TRANSLATION (name-art extension). Letters: the arcade dialogue letters (EXP-0025), 16 rows, 8-pixel advance, centred in the Saturn's own banners (the bar kept); two added glyphs, '&' and the raised dot '·'. Case as the US arcade's name art (cybotsu, EXP-0056). Mech model codes kept from the Saturn art, placed right after the name.
approved: 2026-11-06, the user: "Arcade letters in the banners (Recommended)", "As the US arcade (Recommended)", "Keep, moved after the name (Recommended)", "Devilotte (Recommended)"

style.mech_colours: palette 0x41C0: letters 15/1/2/3, shadow 5, bar 6; model code pixels (indices 10-12) kept
style.model_code: kept, placed right after the name

sources.Devilotte: arcade English text (speaker label); the Saturn art reads 'Princess Devilot'

mechs.sources: BLODIA, REPTOS, FORDY, GULDIN, R·LIGHTNING: US arcade art; the rest: the Saturn art's prefix letter plus the game's own Latin list in CYBER.BIN (EXP-0056), as R·LIGHTNING shows the pattern

not_on_name_art.Tessan: no name art on these screens (EXP-0056); his romanization is SPECIAL-001's

build_switch: tools.text.dialogue --name-art latin (named by the agent; Latin is the default; the katakana stays available for OPT-001)
